nodes.name: BenchmarkApp.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest + Testing Library test suite for BenchmarkApp covering default Capabilities view rendering, 11-row matrix integrity (including the honest competitor-wins row), Memory SOTA tab toggle, and back-toggle — no mocks needed since the component is zero-prop and static.

nodes.name: BenchmarkApp.tsx
nodes.summary: Pure-static React component implementing the Benchmarks screen (screen 17) with two toggled views: a Capabilities competitive-positioning matrix (11 rows, 6 columns including Waggle highlighted in honey) and a Memory SOTA view displaying LoCoMo benchmark results with bar charts and stat chips grounded in real hive-mind benchmark data.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-prop default export with all data hardcoded as const arrays; uses TypeScript discriminated union type `Mark = 'Y' | 'P' | 'N'` for the capability matrix marks, and `ReadonlyArray` for immutable static data constants.

nodes.name: BenchmarkRoute.tsx
nodes.summary: Route wrapper for the `/benchmarks` path that wraps BenchmarkApp inside SurfaceBoundary for error handling and app context — this is a ⌘K-only surface with no direct navigation link.

nodes.name: BenchmarkApp
nodes.summary: Top-level exported component that manages the `view` state toggle (caps/memory) and renders the segmented tab control header plus delegates to CapabilitiesView or MemorySotaView based on selection.

nodes.name: CapabilitiesView
nodes.summary: Renders the competitive positioning view with two framing cards (task agents vs Waggle's memory layer) and an 11-row × 6-column capability matrix table where the Waggle column is honey-highlighted; deliberately shows competitors winning on deep terminal coding.

nodes.name: MemorySotaView
nodes.summary: Renders the Memory SOTA view with proportional bar charts for LoCoMo benchmark results (Waggle 87.66% vs prior SOTA Memori 81.95%) and three stat chip cards with key metrics and honest caveats.

nodes.name: Disclaimer
nodes.summary: Shared disclaimer/caveat block component with an Info icon and muted styling, used by both CapabilitiesView and MemorySotaView to surface honest limitations and methodology notes.
